title: Cross-Lapped Canvas Stretcher
description: One original empty low-poly canvas stretcher lying flat. Four complete miter-ended perimeter rails have outward-rising sloped top faces and broad flat grounded undersides. Two perpendicular complete cross braces have complementary real central half-lap cuts: a lower centre tongue on one brace and an upper centre bridge on the other. Their whole horizontal seat and four complete vertical shoulders form a fixed five-plane joint. Four genuinely open rectangular bays pass through the full assembly. Six closed editable meshes, two constant opaque untextured PBR materials, one prop and zero scenes. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, ground-centred footprint. Every perimeter miter, brace end, central joint and ground sole is a complete finite opposed surface. All geometry is original; no canvas, artwork, backing panel, glass, display leg, movable keys, hardware, old frame conversion or duplicated variant count. Static appearance only: no canvas tension, stretching, keying, dimensional compatibility, assembly path, joinery strength, load, conservation, manufacture, installation or safety certification claim. The original frame-form family remains partial.
